summary: Iteration 31 — code-level diagnostic (no live calls, no fixes). Ran 6 targeted invocations of actual production modules via tsx against typed fixtures. Confirms 6 real bugs from prior report and refutes one (computeRun DOES exclude active=false).

1_normalizeStatus.source: /app/frontend/src/lib/b2g/providers.ts:172-178 — regex order lets 'accepted' win before 'rejected'; word boundaries needed

2_validateB2G_cancelled_invoice.input: otherwise-valid invoice with status='cancelled' (not 'draft'), publicEntity customer, all B2G refs set
returned_errors: Το ΑΦΜ του φορέα δεν είναι έγκυρο.
2_validateB2G_cancelled_invoice.verdict: ALLOWED — validateB2G does NOT block cancelled/void invoices; only line 23 checks status==='draft'. AFM error above is a fixture artifact (099099099 fails checksum); the diagnostic point stands: NO 'cancelled' guard exists. BUG.

3_buildPeppolInvoiceXml_withholding_and_.peppol_invariant_BR-CO-13: TaxInclusive must equal TaxExclusive + TaxAmount → required 124.00, actual 104.00. Withholding is silently absorbed into TaxInclusive. BUG (PEPPOL validation will reject).

credit_note_root.verdict: BUG — UBL 2.1 requires root <CreditNote> with <cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode> and CreditNote-2 namespace. Emitting 381 inside <Invoice> is not valid PEPPOL BIS 3.0.

4_athensIso_offset.verdict: BUG — wall-clock is correctly converted to Europe/Athens (12:00 / 13:00) but the offset suffix stays +00:00 because `off = -d.toLocaleString('en-US', {timeZone: 'Europe/Athens'}).getTimezoneOffset() + d.getTimezoneOffset()` evaluates to 0 when the container TZ is UTC. Result: ERGANI receives a timestamp claiming to be UTC but is actually Athens local time → 2-3 hour drift in every submission. Affects workCardPayload → E12 arrivals/departures.

5_computeItem_and_computeRun_days_source.verdict: BUG (severe) — computeRun (payroll.ts:157) passes `days: overrides.days ?? (empShifts.length ? empShifts.length : undefined)` where empShifts is the COUNT of 'work'-kind shift rows for the month. For a salaried employee with only 1 recorded shift, gross drops from €1200 → €48. Monthly-salaried employees must be paid the full 25 ημερομίσθια regardless of shift count; only hourly/daily should follow shift count.
5_computeItem_and_computeRun_days_source.computeRun_active_filter: CONFIRMED CORRECT — line 143: staff = listEmployees(...).filter(e => e.active && ...). Terminated employees with active=false ARE excluded. Prior iteration's suggestion here is refuted.

6_leaveAllowance_endDate_ignored.verdict: BUG — outputs are IDENTICAL. `leaveAllowance` (bonuses.ts:93) calls `leaveDays(emp, year)` which only reads `emp.hireDate` and `year`; `emp.endDate` is never consulted. An employee that worked 1 day of the year receives the same €600 leave allowance as one who worked all 12 months (subject to grossSalary/2 cap). Note: same-calendar-year hire is correctly prorated to 20 days by leaveDays (hireYear===year, 12 months employed → 20). Prior claim that 'ALL January leavers require prorating in the third calendar year' is NOT verified here and is outside this diagnostic's scope.
6_leaveAllowance_endDate_ignored.source: /app/frontend/src/lib/services/bonuses.ts:39-51, 93-100 (contrast with christmasBonus/easterBonus which correctly use daysWithin including emp.endDate)

critical.issue: Violates PEPPOL BR-CO-13 when withholding present: TaxExclusive+TaxAmount ≠ TaxInclusive (100+24 ≠ 104)
Credit notes emit root <Invoice> with InvoiceTypeCode 381 instead of <CreditNote> + CreditNoteTypeCode + CreditNote-2 namespace
Uses shift-row COUNT as `days` for salaried monthly employees — a salaried employee with 1 shift row is paid 1/25 of gross salary
Offset suffix is derived from container TZ, not Europe/Athens; in UTC container emits '+00:00' while the wall-clock is Athens local → 2-3h timestamp drift in ERGANI E12 submissions
Ignores emp.endDate entirely — terminated employees get full-year allowance

minor.issue: No guard against status='cancelled'/'void' — only 'draft' is rejected. Cancelled invoices can be submitted to Δημόσιο.

refutations_of_prior_report: computeRun DOES filter `e.active` (payroll.ts:143). Terminated employees (active=false) are excluded. Prior claim that 'terminated employees are still paid' is INCORRECT.

'All January leavers require prorating in third calendar year' — NOT proven by any calculation in this run; under Greek labor rules the third calendar year can grant full 22-day entitlement. Prior blanket assertion was overbroad. The actual bug is narrower: endDate is ignored in leaveAllowance.
screenshots_from_iteration30: Not accessed. Iteration 30 report at /app/test_reports/iteration_30.json; any PDF/screenshot artifacts from that run were not regenerated per scope.
action_items: Fix normalizeStatus: use word-boundary regex and check reject/error patterns BEFORE accept patterns; explicit map of known provider strings is safer.
Fix buildPeppolInvoiceXml withholding: emit <cac:WithholdingTaxTotal> (BT-88 category) and ensure TaxInclusive = TaxExclusive + TaxAmount = 124; keep PayableAmount = 104 for the net-payable.
Fix buildPeppolInvoiceXml credit note: switch root to <CreditNote xmlns='...CreditNote-2'>, emit <cbc:CreditNoteTypeCode>, and swap billed-quantity element name.
Fix computeRun days source: for salaried employees (emp.grossSalary > 0) use the standard 25 days unless explicitly overridden; only use empShifts.length for hourly/daily employees.

Fix athensIso: compute the Athens offset from the same formatted parts (or from a fixed table: +02:00 winter / +03:00 summer via Intl formatToParts with timeZoneName). Do not use container's getTimezoneOffset().
Fix leaveAllowance: prorate qualifyingDays by daysWithin({hire..endDate}) / days-in-year, similar to christmasBonus/easterBonus.
Add validateB2G guard: reject invoice.status in ('cancelled','void').
critical_code_review_comments: b2g/ubl.ts:174 — root element is hardcoded to <Invoice> regardless of doctype; violates UBL 2.1 spec for credit notes.
b2g/ubl.ts:215-220 — LegalMonetaryTotal does not model withholding; use only totalGrossValue for PayableAmount and use net+VAT for TaxInclusiveAmount.
b2g/providers.ts:172-178 — status normalization order is wrong (accept regex is too greedy and precedes reject); no test coverage.
services/payroll.ts:157 — coupling of shift-count to salaried gross calculation; needs contract-type branch.
services/ergani-api.ts:30-35 — athensIso is not portable across container timezones; also duplicated logic that should live in a shared helper.
services/bonuses.ts:93-100 — leaveAllowance does not follow the same daysWithin pattern as easterBonus/christmasBonus; inconsistent proration semantics.
services/b2g.ts:16-37 — no lifecycle-status guard for cancelled/void.
